blocks.text: Inherited from Old East Slavic стоꙗти, from Proto-Slavic *stojati (“to stand”), from Proto-Indo-European *stoh₂-.

head: Word
Part of speech
Made of (Wiktionary's etymology)
Meaning (Wiktionary)
rows: state, status, condition; fortune, capital, bankroll
to consist (of); to be a member of, to occupy a position in, to be in a position, to belong to
to lie ahead, to be at hand, to be in the offing; to have to do something in the future
to stand, to stay (for some time); to stand idle
to keep one's balance, to remain on one's feet, to stand one's ground, to stand fast; to resist, to withstand, to stand up (against)
stand (a device to hold something upright or aloft); support
to defend, to protect, to hold against enemy attacks; (figurative) to maintain, to assert
(in the third person with the words дело, всё, etc.) to be, to be going, to be getting on, to stand (of affairs)
